messages:
oliver: Quick update — Hosted streaming + tool-calling with regional fallback to compact quantized replicas is going GA next week. :tada:
oliver: High level: streaming semantics are unified across tool-calls and plain generation, and when a heavy replica is unavailable we’ll route a request to a lower-cost local quantized model to preserve latency SLOs.
oliver: Migration/mode: new projects get the feature enabled by default; existing projects will get a 14-day migration window where they can opt out in Console.
oliver: Docs & migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/streaming-toolcalls-migration (includes example fallback policies and rollback steps)
oliver: Rollout timeline: canary 2026-04-06T06:00:00Z (~10% traffic, region: us-east-1), progressive ramp over two weeks, GA complete by 2026-04-20. Canary keys will be rotated at start.
oliver: Dev/ops checklist: please see bullet list below — ping me if anything blocks.
oliver: - Product: final Console copy for the toggle and the opt-out modal (cc @maria)
oliver: - SDKs: add optional `edge_fallback` config param (see example) and ship tiny patch
oliver: - Observability: emit a `hosted.fallback.count` counter and add `fallback=true` tag to traces
oliver: - Support: update KB & canned responses; create opt-out flow docs
oliver: SDK snippet (pseudo):
```
client.generate({
  model: "mosaic-stream-1",
  streaming: true,
  tool_calls: ["lookup_inventory", "charge_card"],
  edge_fallback: { prefer_region: ["us-east-1"], fallback_model: "mosaic-mini-q8", allow_cost_adjustment: true }
})
```
oliver: Pricing note: when fallback is used the cheaper model consumes tokens billed at its unit price. Quotas remain counted against the request owner; no silent new billing accounts.
maria: I pushed Console copy to the content PR: https://github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/812 — added the opt-out modal text and a one-click toggle on model config.
maria: Also added a small FAQ about accuracy differences when fallback hits.
devon: Re metrics: I recommend both tagging requests and a short-window gauge so SRE can alert if fallback rate spikes. Also add a 5xx counter for fallback failures.
kevin: We'll surface a non-intrusive deprecation banner for the legacy v1 streaming endpoint starting at canary kick-off; one-month deprecation before forced switch. Coordinating customer emails with growth.
emily: Stoked! This should cut P99s for interactive apps a lot. :rocket:
alex: On rollback — we can flip routing policies per-customer immediately if fallback causes regressions. Runbook will include the routing toggle and a model-pin override.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-rollout/hosted-streaming-fallbacks/us-east-1 @ 2026-04-06T06:00:00Z (operator: oliver)
support-bot: support KB stub created: `support/hosted_streaming_toolcall_fallbacks.md` — please populate with common Qs + opt-out steps
devon: SDK PRs opened for js/py with tests; tagging @devex for API review. Plan to merge before canary.
maria: We'll monitor the canary dashboard and hold a 30-minute sync 30 minutes after canary start. I'll post the dashboard link here when available.
oliver: Thanks team — big cross-org effort. If customers hit anything unexpected during canary, tag #eng-runtime and @oliver. Post-canary check-in at 07:00 UTC same day.
